headline: Possible zoning amendments to Tier 3 City Council Special Permit review thresholds for multifamily developments, and an ordinance amendment on historic districts and preservation.
summary: Covers possible zoning changes to Tier 3 City Council Special Permit review thresholds for multifamily development projects. Also covers an ordinance amendment on historic districts under Chapter 49 and historic preservation under Chapter 218.
items: Multifamily development projects in Springfield and possible amendments to the City's Zoning Regulations on Tier 3 City Council Special Permit review thresholds
Ordinance amendment relating to the City's Historic Districts under Chapter 49 and Historic Preservation under Chapter 218
location: Hybrid Room 200, 36 Court Street, Springfield, MA 01103
plain_text:
City Council                                          1                                       HYBRID MEETING 
 
 
                         CITY COUNCIL       
  
                                Planning & Economic Development Subcommittee  
 
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can 
be acted upon at the meeting of the City Council Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 5:00 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Call To Order 
5:00 PM Meeting called to order on October 27, 2026, in Hybrid Room 200, 36 Court Street, 
Springfield, MA 01103.  
 
Roll Call 
 
Public Portion 
 1. Multifamily development projects in the city of Springfield and what possible 
amendment(s) exist to the City's Zoning Regulations regarding the Tier 3—City 
Council Special Permit review thresholds. 
 2. Ordinance amendment relating to the City's Historic Districts under Chapter 49 and 
Historic Preservation under Chapter 218.
